mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_plan (studentid, courseid, title, summary, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{studentid}, #{courseid}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT lp.*, c.coursename FROM learning_plan lp LEFT JOIN course c ON lp.courseid = c.courseid WHERE lp.studentid = #{studentid} ORDER BY lp.id DESC
SELECT lp.*, c.coursename FROM learning_plan lp LEFT JOIN course c ON lp.courseid = c.courseid WHERE lp.id = #{id}
SELECT lp.*, c.coursename FROM learning_plan lp LEFT JOIN course c ON lp.courseid = c.courseid WHERE lp.id = #{id} AND lp.studentid = #{studentid}
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_plan SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND studentid = #{studentid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM learning_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND studentid = #{studentid}
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_plan SET progress_json = #{progressJson} WHERE id = #{id} AND studentid = #{studentid}
